note: 文法形式選擇題（grammar:form-choice）。三個選項只差在文法形式，只有一個正確；options[0] 是正解，出題時請打亂順序。作答前不要顯示時態名稱（會洩漏答案）；作答後再顯示 explain。ctx 建議用 grammar:<主題>/<次主題>，讓跨情境門檻可以計算。

items.stem: This café ___ at seven every morning.
items.en: This café opens at seven every morning.
items.zh: 這家咖啡店每天早上七點開門。
items.explain: every morning 是每天固定發生的事，用現在簡單式；主詞 this café 是單數，動詞要加 -s。

items.stem: The airport bus ___ every twenty minutes.
items.en: The airport bus leaves every twenty minutes.
items.zh: 機場巴士每二十分鐘一班。
items.explain: 時刻表、固定班次用現在簡單式；主詞單數，動詞加 -s。

items.stem: Our team ___ a meeting every Monday.
items.en: Our team has a meeting every Monday.
items.zh: 我們團隊每週一開會。
items.explain: every Monday 是固定習慣，用現在簡單式；our team 視為單數，用 has。

items.stem: Kevin ___ spicy food. He orders it every time.
items.en: Kevin likes spicy food. He orders it every time.
items.zh: Kevin 喜歡辣的食物，他每次都點。
items.explain: like 是表示喜好的狀態動詞，通常不用進行式；主詞 Kevin 是單數，要用 likes。

items.stem: I'm a vegetarian. I ___ meat.
items.en: I'm a vegetarian. I don't eat meat.
items.zh: 我吃素，我不吃肉。
items.explain: 說明一般習慣用現在簡單式；主詞 I 用 don't，不是 doesn't。

items.stem: This train ___ at small stations. It's an express.
items.en: This train doesn't stop at small stations. It's an express.
items.zh: 這班車小站不停，它是快車。
items.explain: 說明列車固定的停靠方式用現在簡單式；主詞 this train 是單數，用 doesn't。

items.stem: I'm sorry, but I ___ with that idea.
items.en: I'm sorry, but I don't agree with that idea.
items.zh: 抱歉，我不同意那個想法。
items.explain: agree 是一般動詞，否定要用 don't；am not agree 是常見錯誤。

items.stem: ___ this soup have meat in it?
items.en: Does this soup have meat in it?
items.zh: 這個湯裡面有肉嗎？
items.explain: 一般動詞 have 的問句用 Does（主詞單數）開頭。

items.stem: ___ the hotel serve breakfast every day?
items.en: Does the hotel serve breakfast every day?
items.zh: 飯店每天都有供應早餐嗎？
items.explain: every day 是固定安排；主詞單數，用 Does。

items.stem: ___ three o'clock work for you?
items.en: Does three o'clock work for you?
items.zh: 三點你方便嗎？
items.explain: work 是一般動詞；three o'clock 視為單數，問句用 Does。

items.stem: What time ___ the last train leave?
items.en: What time does the last train leave?
items.zh: 末班車幾點開？
items.explain: 時刻表用現在簡單式；疑問詞＋does＋單數主詞＋原形動詞。

items.stem: What ___ you usually order here?
items.en: What do you usually order here?
items.zh: 你在這裡通常點什麼？
items.explain: usually 表示習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞 you 用 do。

items.situation: 等餐時看到服務生走過來
items.stem: Look! The waiter ___ our food right now.
items.en: Look! The waiter is bringing our food right now.
items.zh: 你看！服務生正在把我們的餐送過來。
items.explain: Look! 和 right now 表示正在發生，用 be＋V-ing。

items.stem: Please wait. They ___ the plane at the moment.
items.en: Please wait. They are cleaning the plane at the moment.
items.zh: 請稍候，他們正在清潔飛機。
items.explain: at the moment 表示此刻正在進行，用現在進行式。

items.stem: Wait a moment. Amy ___ the slides right now.
items.en: Wait a moment. Amy is fixing the slides right now.
items.zh: 稍等一下，Amy 正在修改投影片。
items.explain: right now 表示正在做，用 is＋V-ing。

items.stem: Don't open the oven! The cake ___ right now.
items.en: Don't open the oven! The cake is baking right now.
items.zh: 別打開烤箱！蛋糕正在烤。
items.explain: 蛋糕此刻在烤，用現在進行式。

items.stem: Sorry, we ___ orders right now. The kitchen is closed.
items.en: Sorry, we aren't taking orders right now. The kitchen is closed.
items.zh: 抱歉，我們現在暫停點餐，廚房關了。
items.explain: right now 加上暫時的狀況（廚房關了），用現在進行式的否定。

items.stem: Look at the gate. People ___ right now; the flight is delayed.
items.en: Look at the gate. People aren't boarding right now; the flight is delayed.
items.zh: 看登機門，現在沒有人在登機，班機延誤了。
items.explain: right now 表示此刻的狀態，用 aren't＋V-ing。

items.situation: 會議中請別人代為記錄
items.stem: Lin ___ notes right now. Can someone else take them?
items.en: Lin isn't taking notes right now. Can someone else take them?
items.zh: Lin 現在沒有在做記錄，可以請別人記嗎？
items.explain: right now 指此刻，用 isn't＋V-ing。

items.stem: ___ you traveling alone?
items.en: Are you traveling alone?
items.zh: 你是一個人旅行嗎？
items.explain: traveling 是 V-ing，前面要用 be 動詞 Are，不能用 Do／Did。

items.situation: 服務生關心等餐的客人
items.stem: ___ you still waiting for your food?
items.en: Are you still waiting for your food?
items.zh: 您還在等餐點嗎？
items.explain: still waiting 是正在進行，用 Are＋主詞＋V-ing。

items.situation: 線上會議確認大家看到同一頁
items.stem: ___ everyone looking at the same slide now?
items.en: Is everyone looking at the same slide now?
items.zh: 大家現在都看著同一張投影片嗎？
items.explain: everyone 文法上是單數，用 Is；looking 是 V-ing，不能配 Does。

items.stem: Where ___ you staying in Tokyo?
items.en: Where are you staying in Tokyo?
items.zh: 你在東京住哪裡？
items.explain: staying 是 V-ing，主詞 you 用 are。

items.situation: 會議中詢問同事的工作
items.stem: What ___ you working on this week?
items.en: What are you working on this week?
items.zh: 你這週在忙什麼？
items.explain: working 是 V-ing，要配 be 動詞；主詞 you 用 are。

items.stem: Sales ___ up last quarter.
items.en: Sales went up last quarter.
items.zh: 上一季業績上升了。
items.explain: last quarter 是過去，用過去式；go 的過去式是不規則的 went。

items.stem: My flight ___ two hours late yesterday.
items.en: My flight arrived two hours late yesterday.
items.zh: 我的班機昨天晚了兩小時抵達。
items.explain: yesterday 是過去，用過去式 arrived。

items.stem: We ___ at a great Thai restaurant last night.
items.en: We ate at a great Thai restaurant last night.
items.zh: 我們昨晚在一家很棒的泰式餐廳吃飯。
items.explain: last night 是過去；eat 的過去式是不規則的 ate。

items.stem: I ___ a room with a view last week.
items.en: I booked a room with a view last week.
items.zh: 我上週訂了一間有景觀的房間。
items.explain: last week 是過去，用過去式 booked。

items.stem: This isn't mine. I ___ this dish.
items.en: This isn't mine. I didn't order this dish.
items.zh: 這不是我的，我沒有點這道菜。
items.explain: 過去式否定是 didn't＋原形動詞；didn't ordered 是常見錯誤。

items.stem: I ___ my bag at the airport yesterday.
items.en: I didn't find my bag at the airport yesterday.
items.zh: 我昨天在機場沒有找到我的行李。
items.explain: yesterday 是過去；didn't 後面用原形 find，不是 found。

items.stem: Sorry, I ___ the file last night.
items.en: Sorry, I didn't send the file last night.
items.zh: 抱歉，我昨晚沒有寄出檔案。
items.explain: last night 是過去；didn't 後面接原形 send。

items.stem: ___ you sleep well last night?
items.en: Did you sleep well last night?
items.zh: 你昨晚睡得好嗎？
items.explain: 過去式問句用 Did＋主詞＋原形動詞；sleep 是一般動詞，不配 Were。

items.situation: 確認對方收到會議邀請
items.stem: ___ you get my email yesterday?
items.en: Did you get my email yesterday?
items.zh: 你昨天有收到我的 email 嗎？
items.explain: yesterday 是過去，用 Did 開頭。

items.stem: ___ the food good last night?
items.en: Was the food good last night?
items.zh: 昨晚的食物好吃嗎？
items.explain: good 是形容詞，要用 be 動詞；last night 是過去，用 Was。

items.situation: 問朋友昨天怎麼找到飯店
items.stem: How ___ you find the hotel yesterday?
items.en: How did you find the hotel yesterday?
items.zh: 你昨天怎麼找到飯店的？
items.explain: yesterday 是過去；疑問詞＋did＋主詞＋原形動詞。

items.stem: When ___ the meeting end yesterday?
items.en: When did the meeting end yesterday?
items.zh: 昨天的會議幾點結束？
items.explain: end 是一般動詞，過去式問句用 did＋原形 end。

items.stem: We bought the tickets. We ___ take the train to Kyoto tomorrow.
items.en: We bought the tickets. We are going to take the train to Kyoto tomorrow.
items.zh: 我們買好車票了，明天要搭火車去京都。
items.explain: 已經有計畫用 be going to；be 動詞不能省略，going 也不能寫成 go。

items.stem: I bought eggs and flour. I ___ bake a cake tonight.
items.en: I bought eggs and flour. I am going to bake a cake tonight.
items.zh: 我買了蛋和麵粉，今晚要烤蛋糕。
items.explain: 事先計畫好的事用 am going to＋原形動詞；漏掉 to 或 be 都不對。

items.stem: Our manager ___ announce the new plan on Friday.
items.en: Our manager is going to announce the new plan on Friday.
items.zh: 我們經理週五要宣布新計畫。
items.explain: 已安排好的計畫用 be going to；主詞單數用 is。

items.stem: I've decided. I ___ order the salad.
items.en: I've decided. I am going to order the salad.
items.zh: 我決定好了，我要點沙拉。
items.explain: 已經決定的打算用 am going to；不能省略 am，也不能寫成 go to。

items.stem: We ___ stay at that hotel again. It was too noisy.
items.en: We aren't going to stay at that hotel again. It was too noisy.
items.zh: 我們不會再住那家飯店了，太吵了。
items.explain: be going to 的否定是在 be 動詞後面加 not，不用 don't。

items.stem: I ___ finish the report today. I need one more day.
items.en: I am not going to finish the report today. I need one more day.
items.zh: 我今天不會完成報告，還需要一天。
items.explain: 否定是 am not going to；don't going to 和漏掉 am 都是錯的。

items.stem: She ___ eat any sugar this month.
items.en: She isn't going to eat any sugar this month.
items.zh: 她這個月不打算吃任何糖。
items.explain: 主詞 she，否定用 isn't going to。

items.situation: 問朋友旅行的交通計畫
items.stem: ___ you going to rent a car?
items.en: Are you going to rent a car?
items.zh: 你打算租車嗎？
items.explain: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞移到前面：Are you going to …?

items.stem: ___ Amy going to join us for dinner?
items.en: Is Amy going to join us for dinner?
items.zh: Amy 會來跟我們一起吃晚餐嗎？
items.explain: 主詞 Amy 單數，用 Is 開頭。

items.stem: ___ they going to move the meeting?
items.en: Are they going to move the meeting?
items.zh: 他們打算改會議時間嗎？
items.explain: 主詞 they，用 Are 開頭。

items.stem: Where ___ you going to stay in Osaka?
items.en: Where are you going to stay in Osaka?
items.zh: 你在大阪打算住哪裡？
items.explain: 疑問詞＋are＋you＋going to＋原形動詞。

items.stem: Who ___ going to send the notes?
items.en: Who is going to send the notes?
items.zh: 誰要負責寄會議記錄？
items.explain: who 當主詞時視為單數，用 is going to。

items.stem: Are you ready to order? — Yes, I ___ have the chicken salad.
items.en: Are you ready to order? — Yes, I will have the chicken salad.
items.zh: 可以點餐了嗎？——好，我要雞肉沙拉。
items.explain: 點餐時當下的決定常用 will（口語 I'll）；I am have 是錯的。

items.stem: Don't worry. I ___ send you the details by Friday.
items.en: Don't worry. I will send you the details by Friday.
items.zh: 別擔心，我週五前會把細節寄給你。
items.explain: 承諾未來要做的事用 will＋原形動詞。

items.stem: The bag looks heavy. I ___ carry it for you.
items.en: The bag looks heavy. I will carry it for you.
items.zh: 包包看起來很重，我幫你拿。
items.explain: 當下主動提議幫忙用 will。

items.stem: Your flight is delayed. You ___ probably miss your connection.
items.en: Your flight is delayed. You will probably miss your connection.
items.zh: 你的班機延誤了，你可能會錯過轉機。
items.explain: 對未來的預測用 will；probably 放在 will 後面。

items.stem: I promise I ___ be late again.
items.en: I promise I won't be late again.
items.zh: 我保證不會再遲到了。
items.explain: 承諾不會做某事用 won't（will not）＋原形 be。

items.stem: Don't order this dish. It's too spicy—you ___ be able to eat it.
items.en: Don't order this dish. It's too spicy—you won't be able to eat it.
items.zh: 別點這道菜，太辣了，你會吃不下。
items.explain: 預測未來不會怎樣用 won't＋原形動詞。

items.stem: Hurry up, or we ___ catch the train.
items.en: Hurry up, or we won't catch the train.
items.zh: 快一點，不然我們會趕不上火車。
items.explain: 「不然就會……」是對未來的預測，用 won't。

items.stem: ___ I miss my connecting flight?
items.en: Will I miss my connecting flight?
items.zh: 我會錯過轉機嗎？
items.explain: 問未來會不會發生用 Will＋主詞＋原形動詞。

items.stem: ___ you be free after lunch tomorrow?
items.en: Will you be free after lunch tomorrow?
items.zh: 你明天午餐後有空嗎？
items.explain: 後面是原形 be，所以前面要用 Will；Are you be、Do you be 都是錯的。

items.stem: ___ you bring us some water, please?
items.en: Will you bring us some water, please?
items.zh: 可以請你幫我們拿些水嗎？
items.explain: Will you …? 可以用來禮貌請求；Do you bring、Are you bring 都不對。

items.situation: 問朋友下個月的住宿天數
items.stem: How long ___ you stay in Taipei next month?
items.en: How long will you stay in Taipei next month?
items.zh: 你下個月會在台北待多久？
items.explain: next month 是未來；疑問詞＋will＋主詞＋原形動詞。

items.situation: 問新主管下週何時到任
items.stem: When ___ the new manager start next week?
items.en: When will the new manager start next week?
items.zh: 新主管下週什麼時候開始上班？
items.explain: next week 是未來；When will＋主詞＋原形動詞。
